qualifier: TLR3 pathway deficiencies in herpes simplex encephalitis and endosomal TLR trafficking
name: Endosomal TLR signaling and herpes encephalitis susceptibility defects
rationale: All members concern endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 signaling, its trafficking (UNC93B1, SLC15A4) and nucleic-acid ligand control, and unlike the interferon- or cGAS-centred confusables the theme carries the TLR3/TICAM1/TRAF3/UNC93B1 HSE deficiencies and endosomal TLR trafficking.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and inhibitor resistance
qualifier: KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR rather than FLT3, ERBB2 or cytokine receptors
name: Oncogenic KIT, PDGFR, ALK, FGFR mutants and inhibitor resistance
rationale: Members are cancer mutants, fusions and TKI-resistant variants of class III and other RTKs (KIT, PDGFR, ALK, FGFR, LTK, FLT3 fusions), distinguishing the theme from FLT3-resistance, ERBB2-mutant and hematopoietic cytokine confusables.

qualifier: cartilage, chondrocyte and joint emphasis
name: Cartilage, chondrocyte and joint-centred skeletal development
rationale: Members cover chondrocyte proliferation/differentiation, endochondral and direct ossification, RUNX2 control, joint and limb morphogenesis, while the confusables focus on osteoblast proliferation/differentiation and Wnt signaling.

qualifier: single-strand annealing repair
name: Double-strand break end resection and single-strand annealing
rationale: Members describe processing/resection of DSB and fork ends and RAD51-independent single-strand annealing repair, distinguishing them from NHEJ, DSB sensing and BRCA/PALB2 homologous recombination confusables.

qualifier: by selective autophagy
name: Autophagic lipid droplet breakdown
rationale: All three members concern lipophagy and its regulation as the route for lipid droplet disassembly, whereas confusables cover droplet formation, fusion and lipogenic or triglyceride synthesis.

qualifier: with proton-coupled di- and oligopeptide transport
name: Amino acid and proton-coupled oligopeptide transmembrane transport
rationale: Members are transport of arginine, leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine, tryptophan, glutamine, alanine, histidine and peptides (including SLC7A7 LPI and vacuolar transport), with the oligopeptide/dipeptide and cationic arginine transport setting the theme apart from lysine/ornithine, polyamine and glycine/proline confusables.

core: Lipid mediator and inflammatory GPCR signaling
qualifier: prostaglandins, leukotrienes, endocannabinoids, histamine and P2Y receptors
name: Prostaglandin, leukotriene, endocannabinoid and histamine GPCR signaling
rationale: Members span arachidonate release and COX/leukotriene synthesis, endocannabinoid/NAE metabolism and their GPCRs together with histamine and P2Y receptors, differing from the lipoxin/HETE and pro-resolving mediator confusables and from ATP/NTPDase signaling.

qualifier: by REV1 and polymerase kappa
name: Error-prone translesion synthesis by REV1 and polymerase kappa
rationale: All members describe mutagenic lesion bypass by REV1 and POLK, distinguishing the theme from error-free POLH bypass, gap-filling repair and replicative DNA synthesis confusables.

qualifier: activated lymphocytes in organised lymphoid tissue
name: B cell signature with lymphoid-tissue lymphocyte activation markers
rationale: Members are two B-cell-enriched modules and a module of activated B/T cell surface markers in lymphoid tissue, distinguishing them from naive/memory, germinal-centre/Tfh and B-cell development confusables.

qualifier: maternal mRNA deadenylation and clearance
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and maternal mRNA clearance
rationale: Members cover M- and Z-decay of maternal transcripts, deadenylation, cleavage divisions and stored maternal cytoplasm/protein, distinguishing the theme from MZT chromatin reprogramming and from general mRNA decay confusables.

qualifier: PINK1-Parkin and receptor mitophagy with fission-fusion and autophagosome assembly control
name: Mitophagy, mitochondrial fission-fusion and autophagosome assembly regulation
rationale: Members regulate mitophagy, mitochondrial dynamics, membrane potential, protein targeting to mitochondria and autophagosome formation, separating the theme from pexophagy/reticulophagy and mitochondrial protein import confusables.

core: Bacterial ligand sensing by surface TLRs
qualifier: TLR2/4/5 with MyD88 and IRAK4 deficiencies
name: TLR2/4/5 bacterial ligand sensing and MyD88-IRAK4 deficiencies
rationale: Members concern LPS, lipopeptide and lipoteichoic acid detection via CD14/TLR2/4/5 and the MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies of these receptors, unlike NOD, inflammasome and cytokine-production confusables.

core: Viral attachment and host cell entry
qualifier: receptor-mediated entry and cell-cell fusion
name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment, entry and cell-cell fusion
rationale: Members describe virion receptor binding, endocytic entry and fusion (dengue, RSV and other viruses), distinguishing the theme from viral protein maturation and entry-regulation confusables.

core: IKK complex recruitment for canonical NF-kappaB activation
qualifier: via IRAK1 and RIP1
name: IRAK1- and RIP1-mediated IKK recruitment to NF-kappaB
rationale: Members describe IKK complex recruitment by IRAK1 or RIP1 and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB, unlike confusables centred on TAK1 activation, IRF3/7 activation or TNFR1 signaling.

qualifier: via PLC-gamma and GRB7 to cell motility
name: ERBB2 and EGFR signaling via PLC-gamma and GRB7
rationale: All members concern ERBB2/EGFR coupling to PLCG1 and GRB7 driving motility, whereas confusables route through GRB2, SHC1 and PI3K or other ERBB pairs.

core: Keratinocyte differentiation and epidermal barrier formation
qualifier: control of keratinocyte proliferation versus differentiation
name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation control and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis and cornification to build the skin barrier, distinguishing the theme from cornified-envelope cross-linking and hair/melanocyte/sebaceous confusables.

qualifier: TRIF- and IRAK-dependent TAK1, IKK and TBK1-IRF3/7 activation
name: TRIF and IRAK adaptor signaling to TAK1 and IRF3/7
rationale: Members describe TRIF/TICAM1 and IRAK-driven TAK1, IKK and TBK1/IRF3/7 activation, TRIF cell death and TLR3-pathway HSE deficiencies, setting the theme apart from IKK-to-NF-kappaB, endosomal TLR trafficking and negative TLR regulation confusables.

qualifier: with hepatic glucokinase regulation
name: Insulin-stimulated glucose disposal and glucokinase regulation
rationale: Members cover insulin receptor recycling and AKT2 activation, insulin-driven glucose import and glycogen synthesis, plus GCK/GKRP regulation and MODY2, distinguishing the theme from insulin secretion and glucagon confusables.

qualifier: microglial differentiation, survival and lysosome organization
name: Microglial and glial activation, proliferation and survival
rationale: Members regulate microglial differentiation, proliferation, migration, activation and cytotoxicity plus astrocyte activation and glial apoptosis, without the amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance content of the confusables.

qualifier: Golgi transporter and synthesis defects
name: Nucleotide-sugar and PAPS donor supply and its disorders
rationale: Members concern synthesis and Golgi transport of UDP-sugars, CMP-sialic acid, GDP-fucose, PAPS and acetyl-CoA and the diseases from their transporter or enzyme defects, distinguishing them from the glycan and glycosaminoglycan biosynthesis confusables.

qualifier: glycogen storage diseases
name: Glycogen and glucose-6-phosphate metabolism and storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, breakdown and glycophagy, hexose-phosphate flux through glycolysis and gluconeogenesis, and the glycogen storage and related G6P-enzyme diseases, distinguishing the theme from fructose and glucagon-signaling confusables.

core: Ribosomal RNA processing and nuclear RNA surveillance
qualifier: rRNA/snRNA/tRNA methylation and exosome-mediated decay
name: Pre-rRNA processing, RNA methylation and exosome nuclear RNA surveillance
rationale: Members span pre-rRNA cleavage and modification, snoRNP assembly, small-RNA methylation and exosome-dependent nuclear RNA decay, distinguishing the theme from splicing, Pol I/III transcription, tRNA processing and pseudouridylation confusables.

qualifier: S-adenosylmethionine, choline, creatine and carnitine
name: Methyl-donor metabolism of SAM, choline, creatine and carnitine
rationale: Members cover SAM metabolism and its defects (MAT1A, AHCY), choline catabolism and the methylation-dependent synthesis of creatine and carnitine, differing from methionine-salvage, phospholipid and short-chain acyl-CoA confusables.

qualifier: monocyte-macrophage recruitment and dendritic cell cytokine output
name: Myeloid chemokine production and monocyte-macrophage recruitment
rationale: Members regulate production of CCL2, CCL3, CCL5, CXCL1/2 and dendritic-cell cytokines and macrophage chemotaxis, distinguishing the theme from Th1/IFN-gamma, inflammasome and neutrophil-recruitment confusables.

qualifier: with cardiomyocyte growth and hypertrophic adaptation
name: Cardiac contractile force and cardiomyocyte hypertrophic adaptation
rationale: Members regulate force, rate and relaxation of heart contraction together with cardiomyocyte growth, sarcomere organization and muscle adaptation, whereas confusables centre on calcium handling and negative regulation of contraction.
